name: Above-threshold cash purchase
description: Buyer presents cash above the AMLR / national threshold; CDD trigger missed.

name: Structured purchases just below threshold
description: Buyer makes multiple purchases just under threshold to avoid CDD.

name: Stolen-goods sale through the dealer
description: Goods of unknown provenance offered for resale.

name: Buyer / UBO matches sanctions list
description: Buyer or beneficial owner matches sanctions list and goods change hands.

name: Cross-border move of high-value goods
description: Goods exported / imported to evade tax or sanctions.
